user_story: As a user, I want to update the priority of an existing task so that I can reprioritize my work.

positive.title: Update task priority successfully
steps: Select an existing task from the task list.
Verify that the task priority is updated to 'High'.
positive.expected_result: The task priority is successfully updated to 'High'.

negative.title: Attempt to update priority of a non-existent task
steps: Try to select a task that does not exist.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the task does not exist.

edge.title: Update task priority with invalid input
steps: Select an existing task from the task list.
Attempt to set the priority to an invalid value (e.g., an empty string or a string that doesn't match any priority level).
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the priority value is invalid.
